title: HF1290 (2023-2024 Regular): Firearm permits to carry without expiration authorized.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2023-02-03; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2023/0/HF/1290/versions/0/)
provenance.note: As filed (introduced version). Sections 1, 2 and 4 strike renewal wording; Section 1 drops the 'original or renewal' training wording. Section 3(c) is quoted with struck words left out.

operative_text:
Section 3 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 7): (c) A permit to carry a pistol issued under this section does not expire.
Section 3 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 7): Permit cards issued after August 1, 2023, must prominently state that the permit does not expire.
Section 5 (replacement permits): A person with a valid permit to carry a handgun issued under Minnesota Statutes, section 624.714, prior to August 1, 2023, shall request a replacement permit card that conforms with the requirements of Minnesota Statutes, section 624.714, subdivision 7, paragraph (c), prior to the expiration date listed on the permit holder's card.
Section 5 (replacement permits): The issuing sheriff may charge up to $10 to issue a replacement card under this section.
